components.principal/credential/challenge carriers: Model,Credential,Response and Attempt retain principal identities,credential ownership,registered challenges,response rows and complete adversary attempt support. witnessMeaning and acceptanceBoundary prove exact support and field matching.
components.exact verification trace: acceptedCredential and exactVerificationTrace prove accepted status iff the complete retained attempt/principal/challenge/credential/response witness exists. Credential acceptance is not assumed to identify the actual actor.
components.impersonation ledger: impersonationMeaning retains exactly every accepted attempt whose actor differs from its claim. exactAuthenticity connects the computed whole-ledger check to actor/claim equality across every accepted supported attempt.
components.acceptance boundary: rejectedImpersonation and acceptedImpersonationFails prove the checked guarantee and its explicit failure witness. unregisteredAttempt,missingChallenge and missingResponse reject unsupported records.
components.source extension: Componentwise Extension,traceExtension and acceptanceExtension retain original credential/response records and complete accepted verification traces. No stronger identity claim than the registered credential/adversary support is made.
components.grammar and controls: Complete original256 candidates,three witnesses,four controls,every source program field/hash and unknown-ID rejection match pinned V3.
